preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 100,000.
There are exactly n-1 edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is between 0 and n.
The maximum number of 1-valid paths is equal to the number of vertices.
The maximum number of n-valid paths is 0.
